title: An efficient estimation of crop performance in sheep fescue (Festuca ovina L.) using artificial neural network and regression models
summary: Artificial neural networks estimated sheep-fescue biological yield from agronomic traits; the best reported model had R² 0.96 in the study’s tested varieties and conditions. The result is limited to the field-trial data and does not establish general performance across regions or cultivars.
